Package de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest

Class BomberQuestGame

java.lang.Object
com.badlogic.gdx.Game
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.BomberQuestGame
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.badlogic.gdx.ApplicationListener
public class BomberQuestGame extends com.badlogic.gdx.Game
The BomberQuestGame class represents the core of the Bomber Quest game. It manages the screens and global resources like SpriteBatch and Skin.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public void create()
      Called when the game is created. Initializes the SpriteBatch and Skin. During the class constructor, libGDX is not fully initialized yet. Therefore this method serves as a second constructor for the game, and we can use libGDX resources here.
